description: Cross-feed signal: for issuers that filed a material 8-K event, show SEC Form 4 insider transactions in the N days BEFORE the event - e.g. insider selling before a bankruptcy, restatement, or delisting. Joins two feeds through the shared entity graph; raw EDGAR cannot answer this in one query.

days_before.description: Lookback window before the event date, default 60.

item_codes.description: 8-K items to anchor on, e.g. ["1.03","4.02","3.01"]. Default: distress items 1.03, 2.06, 3.01, 4.02.

min_value_usd.description: Minimum insider transaction value in USD.

txn_type.description: Insider transaction filter: sell (default - selling before bad news), buy, or all.

name: trades_before_events
title: Insider trades before bad news
